instruction: Use Abaqus via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a linear buckling analysis of a thin plate (Variant B). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Part: Create a 3D Deformable Shell, Planar part. Sketch a square plate from (0, 0) to (120, 120) in the X-Y plane. Partition the plate face using two centerlines at X = 60 mm and Y = 60 mm so that the plate center and the edge midpoints can be selected reliably. Property: Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with thickness = 0.8 mm and 5 integration points. Assign the shell section to the whole plate. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the plate. Step: Create a Linear Perturbation Buckle step named Step-Buckle-B. Request 3 eigenvalues. Mesh: Use a global seed size of 8 mm. Use S4R shell elements and generate the mesh. Load and Boundary Conditions: Represent the compressive edge load of 0.9 N/mm on the two vertical edges by equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X = 0 edge, apply nodal forces in the +X direction. On the X = 120 edge, apply nodal forces in the -X direction. For each loaded edge node, calculate the nodal force as 0.9 N/mm multiplied by that node's tributary edge length. Apply U3 = 0 on all four plate edges: X = 0, X = 120, Y = 0, and Y = 120, to represent simply supported transverse conditions. Select the center mesh node at approximately (X = 60, Y = 60, Z = 0) and apply U1 = U2 = 0 to suppress in-plane translational rigid-body motion. Select the bottom-edge midpoint mesh node at approximately (X = 60, Y = 0, Z = 0) and apply U1 = 0 only to suppress the remaining in-plane rotational rigid-body mode. Job: Create a job named Job-Buckle-B and submit it for solving. Wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Visualization: Review the first buckling mode. Record the first eigenvalue. Save: Save the model database to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-B.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Buckle-B.odb.
